checkpoints.note: First project-code consumption that creates the re-entrant state relevant to the bug. `mrb_ary_splat()` invokes attacker-controlled `to_a`, transferring execution from the current VM frame into a nested VM call that can mutate the callinfo stack.

Root cause on the witnessed path. `mrb_vm_exec()` calls a helper that may re-enter the VM and move/free `mrb->c->cibase`, but vulnerable `OP_ARYCAT` does not refresh its local `ci` alias before later using `regs` derived from that stale pointer. The staged patch inserts `ci = mrb->c->ci;` immediately after this call.
